clinical_text: Patient presents with nasal blockage, thick nasal discharge and facial pain for the past ten days following a cold. No fever at present. Examination shows mucopurulent discharge on anterior rhinoscopy. Started on amoxicillin and saline nasal wash.
Patient has had nasal obstruction, nasal discharge and reduced sense of smell for more than three months. Nasal examination shows polyps. Advised intranasal steroid spray and saline irrigation.
Hypertensive adult presents with sudden bleeding from the right nostril for thirty minutes. Bleeding not controlled by pinching the nose. Anterior nasal packing is being considered.
Young patient with sore throat, fever and painful swallowing for two days. Tonsillar exudate and tender cervical lymph nodes on examination, no cough. Throat swab sent.
Patient with swelling of the neck, fever, difficulty opening the mouth and difficulty swallowing following a tooth infection. Suspected deep neck space abscess, CT neck advised.
Patient reports persistent foul smelling ear discharge for more than three months. Otoscopy shows a central perforation of the tympanic membrane. Ciprofloxacin ear drops with dry mopping advised.

expected_guideline: Hearing Impairment In Pediatric Age Group (0 - 12 Years)
clinical_text: Mother of a two year old child is worried that the child is not speaking and does not respond when called. There is a family history of hearing loss. Hearing evaluation planned.

A fifty two year old man with newly detected hypertension has a blood pressure of 156/98 on two clinic visits. He is asymptomatic. Advised lifestyle changes and planned to start amlodipine and telmisartan.
Patient with blood pressure of 192/124 mmHg complains of severe headache, blurring of vision and chest pain. Needs urgent evaluation at a higher centre.
An eight year old child with fever and migrating pain and swelling of the knees and ankles two weeks after a sore throat. A murmur is heard on auscultation and the ASO titre is elevated.
A three year old child with fever for six days, red eyes without discharge, cracked red lips, strawberry tongue and swelling of the hands and feet. Peeling of the fingertips is noted.

expected_guideline: Pediatric Heart Failure | Left To Right Shunt Lesions
clinical_text: Infant with poor weight gain, sweating while feeding, fast breathing and an enlarged liver. Chest X-ray shows cardiomegaly. Furosemide was started.
A child with sudden onset palpitations and a heart rate above 220 per minute with narrow complex tachycardia on ECG. Haemodynamically stable. Adenosine is being considered.

expected_guideline: Critical Heart Disease In The Newborn
clinical_text: Newborn on the second day of life with bluish discolouration of the tongue and oxygen saturation of 86 percent in the right hand and foot. Pulse oximetry screening failed.
Patient has low back pain for two weeks after lifting a heavy weight. No weakness of the legs and no bladder or bowel complaints. Advised analgesics, back exercises and early return to work.
Office worker with neck pain for ten days radiating to the shoulder, no weakness or numbness of the arms. Advised neck strengthening exercises and paracetamol.
Elderly woman with knee pain on climbing stairs relieved by rest, morning stiffness and crepitus. X-ray shows joint space narrowing. Topical NSAIDs and quadriceps exercises advised.
Elderly woman fell at home and cannot stand. The left leg is short and externally rotated with tenderness over the hip. X-ray pelvis with both hips ordered.
Patient fell on an outstretched hand with pain and swelling over the distal radius and dinner fork deformity of the wrist. X-ray of the wrist advised.
Road traffic accident with an open fracture of the leg bone, a wound of about five centimetres and visible bone. Tetanus prophylaxis and intravenous cefuroxime given.

expected_guideline: Supracondylar Fracture Of Humerus In Children
clinical_text: Six year old child fell on an outstretched arm and has a swollen painful elbow. Radial pulse is present. X-ray shows a supracondylar fracture.
Child with fever, a painful swollen knee and refusal to move the leg for three days. Septic arthritis suspected and joint aspiration is planned.
Patient with depression reports low mood for over a month, loss of interest in usual activities, early morning awakening, poor appetite and fatigue. SSRI and counselling advised.
Patient has excessive worry, palpitations, trembling and episodes of sudden intense fear for the last four months. ECG is normal. Escitalopram started.
Young man with suspiciousness, hearing voices and talking to himself for two months with poor sleep and poor self care. Risperidone is being considered.
Patient drinks heavily every day with morning drinking, craving and tremors when he stops. Liver function tests advised.
Patient has multiple unexplained physical complaints for more than six months with repeated normal investigations and excessive worry about his health.
